E_max > D by 0.010..0.031 and E_min < D for every row

shape_hint: Bolt with a square head: a short square block (width F across flats, height H) sitting on a plain round shank of body diameter E, with a small fillet R under the head and a threaded end of length LT; the head top is slightly chamfered/crowned, seen from the side as a rectangle H high and F wide (G across corners in the other view).

role_map.LT_6in: nominal thread length for bolt lengths up to 6 in
role_map.LT_over6in: nominal thread length for bolt lengths over 6 in

notes: Inch ASME B18.2.1 table only (1/4-1-1/2); UNC thread pitch is not part of this table (coarse UNC applies). Square bolts are normally ASTM A307 Grade A plain. Metric DIN 478 (collar) / DIN 479 / DIN 480 and KS B 1004 were NOT verified in this run (different dimensions; need their own table). F_basic and H_basic are the standard's fractional basic sizes (3 independent sources: torqbolt, metalsin sites, jigneshsteel); all decimal columns have 4-5 sources.

verification.checks_done: Re-fetched torqbolt, pipingpipeline, metalspiping, aft, portland, blacksmith live (200); jignesh only via producer raw copy. Parsed all with tbl.py; full matrix 13 rows x 14 columns x 6 sources (+ pipingpipeline vs metalspiping cross-check): only deviation is blacksmith 7/8 E max 0.875 (typo vs 0.895 in 5 sources). Zero disagreements between torq / metalsin / aft / jignesh / portland on any cell. Per-column independent clusters (min over rows): E_max 5, E_min 4, F_basic 3, F_max 5, F_min 4, G_max 5, G_min 4, H_basic 3, H_max 5, H_min 4, R_max 4, R_min 4, LT_6in 4, LT_over6in 4 (F_basic/H_basic = torq, metalsin, jignesh for 1/4-7/16; +portland from 1/2). AFT table has an extra leading decimal 'basic' column not covered by its header row; alignment confirmed by value match with the other 4 sources.
